cards.notes: Only writer of data/recommender/ratings.json. Refuses a results file whole on any problem; idempotent per batch_id; full reasons to data-local/recommender/reasons/<batch>.jsonl, only top_reason kept (D7). FLOORS 8.

cards.title: Runner prompt persona-rate-batch.md and the planned-routine row in runners.md
cards.notes: Orchestrator reviews the prompt. Agent reads three files, writes one results file, runs merge; no other tool. Routine row is 'Planned', not created.

cards.title: agreement.mjs: alpha, Spearman, within-node tau, test-retest, joint-vs-isolated, persona differentiation, drift
cards.notes: Pure statistics with hand-checked fixtures (Krippendorff's published example); CLI rewrites a report block with --check. FLOORS 9.

cards.title: embed.mjs: evidence-pack embeddings via the passage-index Embedder (stub / transformers / openai)
cards.notes: Keyless live path: cd tools/corpus/embed && npm install (bge-small 384-dim on CPU). Output data-local/recommender/embeddings/. FLOORS 5.

cards.title: Pilot run: ~300 shows, 5-agent pool, retest and isolation checks, pilot report, go/no-go
cards.notes: ORCHESTRATOR STEP. ~44 batches, ~3.5M tokens (estimated), half a day of a <=5-agent local pool. Measures the real tokens of the first three batches. Writes go/no-go for RV-19.

cards.title: student.mjs: ridge regression from features to the rating vector, with the gate
cards.notes: Dependency-free closed-form ridge; never predicts host_style/production/ad_load; gate alpha>=0.80 fit, >=0.67 sub-scores, Spearman>=0.75, within-node tau>=0.6. FLOORS 7.

cards.title: player/recommender.js: persona mixture from interests, prior, shrinkage, blend, DAI penalty
cards.notes: Pure ESM; no storage, fetch, DOM or logEvent (a test greps the source). rankWithPrior changes order within a list only, so the stretch floor is untouched by construction. FLOORS 9.

cards.title: player/recommender-feedback.js: local observations from cp_* keys (completion, history, saved; follows off)
cards.notes: No new cp_ key, nothing sent (D5 checked against privacy-policy.md rows 128/129/131/142). useFollows defaults false because the cp_starred_shows row (139) promises follows never change what is surfaced; RV-24 queues the wording. FLOORS 8.

cards.notes: Gated on #1163 item 17.2. Score questions with 5 anchored levels; metadata only (no transcript windows leave). Adds --into to merge (default ratings.json). FLOORS jev-rate 6; merge 8 -> 9.

cards.notes: Curated 229 only in v1; digit-per-persona f string; CLIENT_BUDGET_BYTES 40 KB pinned by a real-data test; not fetched by app.js until RV-27 (zero bundle). FLOORS 5.

cards.title: Gold-set run: 3,000-5,000 shows, three passes on 500, sharded pool or routines
cards.notes: ORCHESTRATOR STEP, after RV-13's go. ~200 batches, ~20M tokens (estimated) for 3,000; 2-4 calendar days of a 5-agent pool, or ~2 weeks on five routines (fallback). batchDrift > 0.3 triggers the pairwise-calibration backlog item.

cards.notes: --predict refuses when the gate failed; holdout never trains; gold-rated and none-tier shows excluded; audio sub-scores always null; --check binds model to gold set and predictions to model. FLOORS 6.
